uncertainty: Four verified package paths cover three parser families on two valid untagged CBR controls: Symphonia's Rust MP3 demuxer/decoder, reached directly through symphonia-bundle-mp3 and through the symphonia facade's probe and codec registry; minimp3's C decoder through the Rust minimp3 binding; the mp3-duration frame-header scanner, which reports only a summed duration. The symphonia facade is a separate package API over the same Symphonia family, not a new engine. Eight leads remain unresolved, so the verified ranks are not a claim about all MP3 parsers. Search covers the first 100 hits of six crates.io queries (591 hits, 350 unique) captured 2026-11-17; the 'mp3' query alone reports 1119 matches. Recent downloads include transitive dependency pulls and are an adoption proxy, not evidence of direct MP3 parsing use. The two controls do not establish VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II or MPEG-2.5 support.
